title: EV Charging Rate Card for Parking License Holders
content:
Energy and idle figures of the Parking License, by parking product. Only the EV Charging Reserved Space comes with a dedicated Level 2 charger; holders of every other product charge at the community's shared chargers.

## Charger and vehicle terms

| Parking product | Dedicated Level 2 charger with the space | Space may be licensed only for a plug-in electric vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | No | No |
| Surface Reserved Space | No | No |
| Covered Carport Space | No | No |
| Structured Garage Space | No | No |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | Yes | Yes |
| Private Detached Garage | No | No |

## Energy rates (USD per kWh)

| Parking product | Dedicated charger, 07:00 to 21:00 local time (on-peak) | Dedicated charger, 21:00 to 07:00 local time (off-peak) | Shared chargers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.38 |
| Surface Reserved Space | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.38 |
| Covered Carport Space | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.38 |
| Structured Garage Space | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.38 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | $0.32 | $0.24 | $0.00 |
| Private Detached Garage | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.38 |

## Idle and session figures

| Parking product | Idle grace period after charging completes | Idle fee per hour | Maximum hours per shared-charger session |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 4 |
| Surface Reserved Space | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 4 |
| Covered Carport Space | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 4 |
| Structured Garage Space | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 4 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 0 |
| Private Detached Garage | 30 minutes | $12.00 | 4 |

## Reading the card

- The on-peak and off-peak rates are dedicated-charger rates, so they are above $0.00 only for the EV Charging Reserved Space ($0.32 and $0.24).
- The shared-charger rate of $0.38 per kWh is the figure for licensees without a dedicated charger; the EV Charging Reserved Space shows $0.00 in that column and 0 in the session-hours column.
- The idle grace period (30 minutes) and the idle fee per hour ($12.00) are the same figures for every product.
